headline: Nigerian Naira Weakens 0.22% as Official Trading Slows
summary: The Nigerian naira depreciated 0.22% to N1,349 per dollar, while official market trading slowed to approximately $1.45 billion.
why: Exchange rate fluctuations impact import costs and foreign exchange reserves in import-reliant economies.

impacts.name: USD/NGN
impacts.why: The naira weakened against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Trading volumes on the official market slowed down amid foreign exchange adjustments.
